'''mrwaltdog MInd What You Have Learned''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 28 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Bog Clearing|Dagobah-L-dagobahbogclearing.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah: Bog Clearing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Dagobah Bog Clearing mrwaltdog LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is with all the modifications from my older version. Thankx for the reccomendations. What do you guys think?

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I use Rycar Ryjerd (V) to pull reflection and bionic hand. This is so I have a 7 in case my r2 in r5 cards bite the dust some how. The Signals are there to pull out my effects. Most importatly Traffic Control and battle plans (don't have the shield). Sao'torr Kal Fas (V) is there so that I can use mains and their sabers for beatdown (don't own any of the EPP cards either). Hopefully my opponent grabs It Could Be Worse and allows me to use On the Edge. Life Debt and HCF are in here to drop and give some serious beatdown to any lone ships waiting around. Also if I see HCF getting into a bind I can just sac them and then retreive them later on then pull them into my hand with test #4.

Thanks For the help guys. I do have to say this deck looks alot scarier than my last one.
